text:
Aisha (Design): quick design review for the error timeline — uploaded a compact variant here: https://figma.com/... :eyes:
Aisha (Design): goal: surface the hot paths + correlation id without overwhelming small screens. want copy + a11y check.
Tom (Eng): reading now. main question: keyboard nav for collapsed stack frames? can you show expected focus order?
Aisha (Design): focus order: timeline row -> expand chevron -> stack frame list -> frame actions (copy, open). keyboard: Enter toggles, Space copies correlation id. wondering if `aria-expanded` on chevrons is enough.
Lena (Eng-UX): prefer explicit `aria-controls` + `aria-expanded`. also add a skip link for the long stack trace: `a.skip-to-frames` so screen readers can jump.
Tom (Eng): agree. small code sample we can use for copy button aria:
```
<button aria-label="Copy correlation id 4a1f-..." class="copy-btn">Copy</button>
```
Ravi (Product): copy wording: current label is "Export" but users expect format info. propose: `Export (HAR)` or a split menu: "Export" + caret -> `Export HAR`, `Export JSON`.
Aisha (Design): like split menu. for the primary CTA use `Export` with tooltip that shows chosen format. also changed small copy: instead of "Show stack" use "Expand frames" — clearer?
Lena (Eng-UX): "Expand frames" is good. accessibility nit: ensure contrast for the mute timestamp text — current #6b7280 fails on small text. suggest #4b5563 or bump weight.
Tom (Eng): noted. also for the correlation ID we should make it a single-line chip with `role=button` and `tabindex=0` so it behaves like a copy control on keyboard-only. add `title="Copy correlation ID"` for tooltip fallback.
Aisha (Design): UX decision: default to collapsed frames for traces > 8 frames, show "Expand frames (8)". also show inline top N frames then a "Show more" link. thoughts?
Ravi (Product): +1, helps scanability. metric-wise we can A/B test collapsed-by-default vs expanded for error triage speed.
Lena (Eng-UX): quick a11y checklist: 1) focus ring visible on all interactive elements 2) aria labels for export items 3) contrast >4.5 for body text 4) keyboard only flows documented.
Tom (Eng): implementation note: correlation id copy should call `navigator.clipboard.writeText(id)` and fire a toast with `aria-live="polite"`. also watch for iframe contexts.
Aisha (Design): copy tweaks suggested:
- header: "Request details" -> "Request & trace"
- correlation chip: "Copy ID" -> tooltip text "Copied!" after action
- export menu item: "Download" -> "Export trace (HAR)"
Ravi (Product): minor: rename route from `/trace/:id/export` -> `/trace/:id/download` to match product docs? maybe keep `export` for consistency with other features.
Lena (Eng-UX): accessibility + microcopy done in figma comments. I left alt text suggestions for the timeline svg bars.
ops-bot: Automated accessibility scan completed: 2 warnings found (low contrast on timestamp, missing `aria-expanded` on chevrons). See CI run: https://ci.internal/scan/1779
Aisha (Design): thanks — I'll update the frames copy + contrast and post a follow-up mock with keyboard flow screenshots. :thumbsup:
Tom (Eng): I'll pick up the copy button behavior + aria-live toasts. plan to PR next sprint.
Ravi (Product): moving to backlog grooming, will add A/B test ticket.
Aisha (Design): cool — follow-up comment when figma is updated and I'll re-request review.
